caseName: Tahoe-Sierra Preservation Council, Inc. v. Tahoe Regional Planning Agency
caseNameFull: Tahoe-Sierra Preservation Council, Inc. v. Tahoe Regional Planning Agency

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: *949“Whether the Court of Appeals properly determined that a temporary moratorium on land development does not constitute a taking of property requiring compensation under the Takings Clause of the United States Constitution?”
